snippet.title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 - Floating Cities DLC
snippet.description:
A NEW DLC to Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 is coming on Steam! 🔥 Get ready and face off against the new colossus in Floating Cities DLC! Available form December 12, 2024 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3142330/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator_2__Floating_Cities_DLC/

Set sail for new horizons with the Floating Cities DLC - this time, the challenge takes place on luxurious passenger ships that offer more than just scrap – they hold hidden treasures waiting to be uncovered!

---
